# Code of Conduct

[简体中文](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

## Purpose

This project wants technical discussion to stay technical discussion. What follows applies to issues, pull requests, code review, commit messages, and any exchange carried out in the name of this project.

## Expected

- Address the work. Judge code, designs and tradeoffs, not the person who proposed them
- Give the reason. "This won't work" helps nobody; "this fails on a read only root filesystem because …" does
- Assume the information gap is real. Nobody else can see the constraint in your head, so explain before concluding
- Accept "no" as an answer. A rejected feature is usually a scope decision, not a verdict on the person who asked
- Respect the maintainer's time. One person runs this project and replies will be slow

## Not acceptable

- Personal attacks, demeaning remarks, and harassment targeting someone's identity
- Sexualised language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention
- Harassment in public or private, including continued contact after being asked to stop
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission
- Deliberate disruption, such as repeatedly filing noise or hijacking unrelated threads to pick a fight
- Anything a reasonable person would recognise as inappropriate in a professional setting

## On AI generated content

Tool assisted code and prose are allowed, but you are responsible for what you submit. Bulk generated content submitted without being read and verified will be closed, because the cost of reviewing it has been handed to the maintainer. Say in the pull request which parts were tool generated.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may remove, edit or reject any comment, commit, code or issue that does not follow this document, and will state the reason when doing so. Sustained or serious violations lead to a temporary or permanent ban from this project's spaces.

## Reporting

Contact the maintainer through their [GitHub profile](https://github.com/babywbx).

If the report concerns the maintainer, or the behaviour already breaks GitHub's terms of service, use [GitHub's abuse reporting](https://github.com/contact/report-abuse).

Reports are taken seriously and handled confidentially.

## Scope

This document applies across all of the project's spaces, and to behaviour when representing the project in public.
